preregisteredBefore: OOF prediction generation, selector training, and July-August evaluation
source: r4 run 35940833546 artifacts, unchanged pre-race feature cache and original pinned sources

split.require: max(fit day) < min(validation day) and max(validation day) < min(predict day); no same-day label exposure

modelA.estimator: r4 reaction three-stage conditional grouped-softmax LightGBM with r4 hyperparameters and June-like fold validation/temperature choice; no new hyperparameter search
modelA.developmentModel: reuse frozen r4 reaction model from run 35940833546; Jan-May fit, June early stopping and temperature; no July-August labels in training

market.definition: normalize reciprocal of all 120 positive finite historical trifecta odds within a race
market.invalid: exclude entire race if any of 120 odds is absent, nonfinite or nonpositive; never impute odds
market.limitation: archive odds timestamp is not proven five minutes before close

selector.raw_ratio: use unaltered Model A probability; additionally require model/market >= 1.2 per ticket
selector.logistic_residual: L2 logistic regression C=0.01, fit_intercept=true, random_state=1604, max_iter=200 on March-June OOF ticket labels; inputs log(market) and clipped log(model/market) [-4,4]; normalize predicted ticket probability across each race
selector.fit: only March-June forward OOF predictions and outcomes; July-August is evaluation only
selector.choice: among passing candidates maximize July-August ROI without largest hit; tie-break larger buys then fixed alphabetical name; otherwise candidate null

buying.ticketSelection: reuse r4/core tickets algorithm exactly, with chosen selector probability and additionally raw ratio eligibility where applicable
buying.accounting: 100 yen units; exactly 1200 yen per purchased race; use actual trifecta return per 100 yen on winning ticket; no purchase means zero stake and payout; exclude ineligible races

purchase: absolute predicted expected vs realized ROI gap

dailyBootstrap.unit: calendar day; resample complete day stake and payout together

developmentGate.annualGate: NOT_EVALUATED: two development months cannot establish annual 105% ROI or multiyear reproducibility

leakageGuards: reject any dates after August 2025 before reading any cache or artifact
cache history_through strictly earlier than race day
all fold train/validation days strictly precede prediction day
reject duplicate day/venue/race keys, NaN probabilities, probability sum not one, missing 120 combinations
verify artifact SHA and preregistration commit SHA in every output manifest
no re-search of r1-r4 thresholds, no longshot, no production promotion
